items.headline: Seven detached ADUs permitted at one N 2nd St property
items.summary: Permits were issued for seven separate two-story detached accessory dwelling units (#9-15) at 584 N 2nd St, each valued near $569,000. The uniform scale points to a multi-unit ADU development on a single lot rather than a single homeowner addition.

items.headline: Three single-family homes permitted on Beach Hill Farm St
items.summary: Permits cleared for three new single-family homes at 2556, 2558, and 2560 Beach Hill Farm St, part of the Comm Hill 3.2 project, each valued around $412,000-$417,000.

items.headline: Zoning tweak would allow housing in ROLM(E) district
items.summary: Palo Alto's Economic Development Committee is recommending a City Council ordinance clarifying that multiple-family residential uses can be conditionally permitted in the ROLM(E) zone, part of the Office, Research, and Manufacturing zoning chapter.

items.headline: Council to hear appeal of Civic Center Drive townhome project
items.summary: Santa Clara City Council is scheduled to consider an appeal of a permit approval for a project at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street that would demolish existing buildings and build 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space.

items.headline: Public scoping meeting for Oakmead Parkway housing project
items.summary: Sunnyvale held a public scoping meeting for the environmental review of a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway, gathering input on what the environmental impact report should study.

items.headline: City Council to respond to grand jury pothole report
items.summary: The council is set to approve its formal response to a Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury report on improving how the county processes pothole damage claims.

items.headline: New five-year deal for traffic control at Stanford games
items.summary: The council is considering a five-year agreement with Stanford University for the city to provide traffic control services during events at Stanford Stadium.
